carousels.title: Mortgage Rates on the Rise
carousels.caption: Stay informed about the latest mortgage rate trends. Understanding why rates fluctuate helps you make confident decisions about your home financing. Let's explore what's happening and how SafeTrust can help you navigate it. #MortgageRates #HomeBuying #SafeTrustMortgage
carousels.hero_sub: 30-year conforming rates have risen past 6.75%, reaching an average of 6.77% amidst persistent inflation concerns.
carousels.problem_sub: Fluctuating inflation expectations and hawkish Federal Reserve messaging are influencing mortgage rate movements.
carousels.solution_sub: Understanding the factors driving rates allows you to position yourself strategically in the market.
carousels.quote: Proactive engagement with current market data and expert guidance is key to securing favorable mortgage terms.

features.label: Inflation Expectations
features.desc: 1-year inflation expectations have risen to 3.7%, impacting bond yields and mortgage rates.

features.label: Federal Reserve Stance
features.desc: The Fed's hawkish messaging indicates a continued focus on controlling inflation.

features.label: 30-Year Conforming
features.desc: Average rates for 30-year conforming loans are now 6.77%.

features.label: Jumbo Loans
features.desc: Rates for jumbo loans are closely following, averaging 6.75%.

carousels.details_sub: Higher rates directly affect your monthly mortgage payments and overall affordability.

carousels.title: A More Balanced Housing Market
carousels.caption: Good news for homebuyers! More real estate agents are reporting a balanced market, indicating shifts in buyer and seller dynamics. Find out what this means for your home search. #HousingMarket #BalancedMarket #HomeBuyers
carousels.hero_sub: Far more real estate agents are now reporting a balanced housing market, according to a recent CNBC survey.
carousels.problem_sub: Previous markets were characterized by intense competition or significant price growth, making it tough for buyers.
carousels.solution_sub: A balanced market offers buyers more negotiation power and a less frenzied home search experience.
carousels.quote: The decrease in reported price cuts suggests a market settling into a more sustainable rhythm for both buyers and sellers.

features.label: Fewer Price Cuts
features.desc: The number of agents reporting at least one price cut to active listings has dropped dramatically.

features.label: Increased Stability
features.desc: This signals a move away from the frantic pace of recent years towards more predictable conditions.

features.label: Better Negotiations
features.desc: Buyers may find more room for negotiation on price and terms.

features.label: More Time to Decide
features.desc: Less pressure means you can take a more considered approach to your home purchase.

carousels.details_sub: A balanced market can lead to a more confident and less stressful home-buying journey.

steps.title: Refine Your Search
steps.desc: With more options, focus on homes that truly meet your needs and preferences.

steps.title: Get Pre-Approved
steps.desc: Show sellers you are a serious and ready buyer, even in a balanced market.

steps.title: Work with an Agent
steps.desc: Leverage expert advice to navigate negotiations and find value.

steps.title: Stay Patient
steps.desc: Take your time to find the right home at the right price.

carousels.cta_sub: A balanced market is an excellent time to make your move. Let SafeTrust help you secure your dream home.

carousels.title: NC Parking Reform: A Boost for Housing
carousels.caption: North Carolina has passed aggressive parking reform, a move that could significantly impact housing development and affordability across the state. Discover what this means for future communities! #HousingReform #NorthCarolina #UrbanPlanning
carousels.hero_heading: NC Kicks Parking Rules to the Curb
carousels.hero_sub: North Carolina passed one of the country's most aggressive statewide parking reforms, aiming to ease housing development.
carousels.problem_sub: Minimum parking mandates often inflate housing costs, limit density, and contribute to urban sprawl.
carousels.solution_sub: Removing strict parking mandates allows for more flexible development, potentially leading to more affordable housing options.
carousels.quote: What started as a stormwater management bill became a landmark reform, easing development constraints across North Carolina.

features.label: Eliminates Mandates
features.desc: The reform largely removes statewide minimum parking requirements for new developments.

features.label: Promotes Density
features.desc: Developers can now build more housing units on less land without needing excessive parking.

features.label: Reduces Costs
features.desc: Lower construction costs from reduced parking infrastructure can lead to more affordable housing.

features.label: Encourages Walkability
features.desc: Allows for the creation of more pedestrian-friendly communities.

carousels.details_sub: This reform can foster more vibrant, affordable, and sustainable neighborhoods across North Carolina.

steps.title: Increased Housing Options
steps.desc: Expect to see a broader range of housing types and densities in certain areas.

steps.title: Smarter Development
steps.desc: New projects can better align with community needs and transit options.

steps.title: Cost Savings
steps.desc: Potential for lower rental and purchase prices due to reduced development overhead.

steps.title: Community Planning
steps.desc: Local governments may adapt their zoning to reflect this new flexibility.

carousels.cta_sub: As North Carolina evolves, SafeTrust Mortgage is here to help you navigate your home financing options. Talk to us about finding your place in these changing communities.
